review_method: Every figure was drawn by scripts/figs_*.py from the lesson formulas and rasterized from its SVG twin with headless Microsoft Edge. All figures were inspected in four-panel contact sheets; figures with overlaps, clipped labels or wrong scales were corrected and reinspected. The PPTX files were written by the same scene JSON and reopened with python-pptx. PowerPoint and LibreOffice were not available, so the PPTX files themselves were not rendered by an Office renderer.
checks: geometry and direction match the local equation
numerical values recomputed from the lesson formulas
schematic or illustrative values labelled as such
limitations: Schematics describe the adopted lesson models and their declared assumptions.
Illustrative values are labelled as such in each figure.
revision: Original physical geometry preserved; old E12 deleted; later IDs migrated by frozen-byte mapping. Historical receipt preserved in baseline archive. Browser SVG and native object checks recorded separately.
